Package com.egradx.auth.token

Class EgradxTokenIssuer

java.lang.Object
com.egradx.auth.token.EgradxTokenIssuer
public class EgradxTokenIssuer extends Object
Issues locally-signed RS256 access tokens using the RSA signing key shared with the rest of the SDK (egradx-sig-key, from egradx-tls-provider). Tokens produced here are verifiable by EgradxJwtTokenUtil.verifyAccessTokenLocal(String) with no external issuer/JWKS round-trip — everything needed to issue and verify a token lives inside the same app.

The token carries identity only — organizationId and roleId say which organization/role context this session is scoped to, but neither is trusted for authorization decisions. It carries no authorities/scope claim at all: those are resolved fresh from the database on every request by EgradxPermissionResolver, which also re-derives the user's current role for that organization — ignoring this token's roleId claim — so a role reassignment takes effect on the user's very next request, not their next login. Both id claims are omitted entirely (not written as null) when there isn't one — the platform owner has no organizationId, and a user with no role yet in the relevant context has no roleId.
